name: Shadra: Owlcat Rend applies and escalates Festering Wound
contract: She is level 60 and defensive. Every third landed melee swing casts Owlcat Rend for direct damage and advances the victim's Festering Wound: rank 1004211 (20 per 2 s) first, then rank 1004212 (40) on the next Rend. The bleed ticks must deal damage to the attacker.

steps.label: First Rend applies the rank one wound
Rank one wound ticks for at least ten after mitigation
